findings.title: Supplier bank account changed
findings.description: INV-200 requests payment to an account that differs from PO-200.
findings.recommendation: Block payment and verify the change through an independent, pre-established supplier contact channel.

findings.title: Supplier bank account changed
findings.description: INV-200-COPY requests payment to an account that differs from PO-200.
findings.recommendation: Block payment and verify the change through an independent, pre-established supplier contact channel.

findings.title: Possible duplicate invoice
findings.description: Multiple invoices share supplier, external reference, currency, and total.
findings.recommendation: Block payment and have Accounts Payable verify invoice lineage and prior payment status.

findings.title: Document contains an embedded control-bypass instruction
findings.description: Extracted text in INV-200 contains content that must be treated as untrusted data, not an instruction.

evidence.observed: approve without review, ignore prior instructions, system override

findings.recommendation: Quarantine the document for human review and do not execute instructions found inside document content.

findings.title: Document total is inconsistent
findings.description: INV-200 does not reconcile to its line items and tax calculation.
findings.recommendation: Block automated approval and reconcile the arithmetic against the original source.

findings.title: Document total is inconsistent
findings.description: INV-200-COPY does not reconcile to its line items and tax calculation.
findings.recommendation: Block automated approval and reconcile the arithmetic against the original source.

findings.title: Invoice quantity exceeds recorded delivery
findings.description: INV-200 bills more STL-500 than the delivery note records.
findings.recommendation: Hold the affected line and verify receipt with the site and commercial teams.

findings.title: Invoice quantity exceeds recorded delivery
findings.description: INV-200-COPY bills more STL-500 than the delivery note records.
findings.recommendation: Hold the affected line and verify receipt with the site and commercial teams.

findings.title: Required high-value approval is missing
findings.description: INV-200 lacks approved roles required by the active policy.
findings.recommendation: Route the document to the missing approval roles before any payment or commitment.

findings.title: Required high-value approval is missing
findings.description: INV-200-COPY lacks approved roles required by the active policy.
findings.recommendation: Route the document to the missing approval roles before any payment or commitment.

findings.title: Required high-value approval is missing
findings.description: PO-200 lacks approved roles required by the active policy.
findings.recommendation: Route the document to the missing approval roles before any payment or commitment.

findings.title: Invoice unit price exceeds policy tolerance
findings.description: Line STL-500 in INV-200 differs from the purchase order price.
findings.recommendation: Require an approved change order or corrected invoice before payment.

findings.title: Invoice unit price exceeds policy tolerance
findings.description: Line STL-500 in INV-200-COPY differs from the purchase order price.
findings.recommendation: Require an approved change order or corrected invoice before payment.
